summary: Iteration 6 (Other industry -> free-text description) verified end-to-end. Backend: 46 total tests; 44 pass. New /app/backend/tests/test_custom_industry.py (3/3 pass): (a) POST /api/onboarding/suggest with free-text sentence 'We run a mobile pet grooming and dog walking service' returns 3-6 industry-relevant roles (no 'owner') and 0-5 products; (b) POST /api/auth/register with a sentence as industry stores the sentence verbatim and /api/auth/me returns the same sentence; (c) preset 'Technology / SaaS' still returns valid suggestions. 2 flaky failures in TestDecisionApproval are pre-existing parallel-execution state pollution (pending decisions consumed by concurrent workers); they PASS in isolation and are unrelated to iteration 6. Frontend E2E (1280x900): (1) Register wizard step-1 -> step-2 works. (2) industry-select has 28 options (26 industries + blank + 'Other'), confirming expanded list. (3) custom-industry-wrap is HIDDEN by default and for preset 'Technology / SaaS'. (4) Selecting 'Other' reveals custom-industry-input textarea. (5) Validation: with 'Other' + empty textarea, onboarding-suggest-button shows auth-error 'Please describe your industry in a short sentence' and does NOT advance. (6) Filling sentence -> AI returned highly relevant chips: ['Lead Groomer','Dog Walker','Booking Coordinator','Van & Equipment Technician'] and 5 pet-grooming products (Mobile Full Groom, Bath & Brush Out, 30/60-Min Dog Walk, Puppy's First Groom Package). (7) Step-3 header shows the custom sentence. (8) onboarding-create-button routes to '/'. (9) /team profile-industry shows the sentence; products-card lists AI products. REGRESSION preset flow: Technology / SaaS shows 6 chips, header shows preset label, tenant.industry stores 'Technology / SaaS' verbatim. REGRESSION Sharma demo: owner login works, dashboard loads, /workflows testids workflow-tab-sales_dispatch & workflow-tab-purchase_payment present, /team profile-industry='Textile Manufacturing', Ask AI + Brain load. REGRESSION mobile 390x844: bottom nav visible, no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: TestDecisionApproval::test_reject_by_sales_forbidden and test_approve_by_owner_unblocks_tasks are flaky under pytest-xdist parallel execution (pending decisions consumed by a concurrent worker approving one). Pass in isolation. Pre-existing, not iteration 6. Consider using a per-test seeded decision (create_test_decision fixture) instead of relying on dashboard['pending_decisions'][0].

action_items: (Non-blocking) Refactor TestDecisionApproval to seed its own decision instead of picking pending_decisions[0] to eliminate parallel-run flakiness.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.js:69 fetchSuggestions cleanly computes eff = industry==='Other' ? customIndustry.trim() : industry; validation on empty is early-return with auth-error — matches spec.

Login.js:72 setResolvedIndustry(eff) is called BEFORE the async /onboarding/suggest call; if the AI call fails, the toast fires and step advances to 3 with resolvedIndustry already set to the sentence — which is the desired behavior (user can still edit).
Login.js:109 submitRegister sends industry: resolvedIndustry || form.industry — correct for both Other (sentence) and preset paths.
Login.js:230 conditional rendering `form.industry === 'Other' &&` correctly hides/shows the custom-industry-wrap div; the textarea uses rows={2} and resize-none for consistent UX.
format.js:16 INDUSTRIES expanded to 26 concrete entries + 'Other' (27) — dropdown shows 28 including the empty placeholder, matches user request for a much longer list.

backend server.py accepts industry as free-form string — no server-side validation issue found; register stores it verbatim as verified by TestFreeTextIndustry::test_register_with_custom_industry_sentence.

Minor: customIndustry state is never reset when the user switches from 'Other' back to a preset. If user picks 'Other', types text, then switches to 'Manufacturing', the (hidden) textarea value remains in state. Since fetchSuggestions uses eff = industry==='Other' ? customIndustry : industry, this is harmless — but worth cleaning up for tidiness.

TestDecisionApproval in backend_test.py is flaky under -n auto parallel execution (pre-existing) — either mark it serial or seed its own decision.
rca of the issue: No iteration-6 issues. Flaky decision-approval tests: parallel workers race on shared seed decisions — one approves it, subsequent workers see empty pending_decisions[]. Mitigation: create per-test decision inside the test itself (or scope xdist to run TestDecisionApproval serially with @pytest.mark.serial + --dist=loadfile).
